key_points: CVS raised 2026 revenue and earnings guidance, but flagged reimbursement pressure, macro headwinds, and soft front-store demand
Judge approved bankruptcy plan for Omnicare unit, making creditors (including DOJ) whole — legal overhang partially resolved
$949M fraud verdict forced a CVS business into Chapter 11, a material negative headline despite contained fallout
Stock slid to ~$87–89, pushing dividend yield to ~3%; valuation debate centers on whether yield is bargain or warning
Defensive sector rotation may provide near-term support, but execution risks and legal/regulatory noise weigh on sentiment
